sentences.en: In this, the so-called Year of the Woman, this culmination of years of sacrifice and hard work, we women have been saying for a long time that if we
sentences.zh: 在这个所谓的“女性之年”，在多年牺牲和努力的结晶时刻，我们女性长期以来一直在说，如果我们

sentences.en: were in power, we would do it differently.

sentences.en: You had George H.W.
sentences.zh: 当时是老乔治·H·W·

sentences.en: Bush running for re-election, a Republican sort of grandfatherly figure who had replaced another grandfatherly Republican, Ronald Reagan, in the White House.
sentences.zh: 布什竞选连任，他是一个祖父式的人物，在白宫接替了另一个祖父式的共和党人罗纳德·里根。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.en: Kate Zernicki covers politics for The Times.

sentences.en: But by far the biggest motivator for women running that year and the reason that it was
sentences.zh: 但迄今为止，促使女性在当年参选的最大动力以及被称为“女性之

sentences.en: the Year of the Woman was the events of the previous year, 1991, with the Anita Hill hearings.
sentences.zh: 年”的原因，是前一年即1991年发生的安妮塔·希尔听证会事件。

sentences.en: I believe the Clarence Thomas-Anita Hill hearing was a big turning point in this country.
sentences.zh: 我相信克拉伦斯·托马斯与安妮塔·希尔的听证会是这个国家的一个重大转折点。

sentences.en: Mr. Marshall, sir, what about Mr. Marshall?
sentences.zh: 马歇尔先生，先生，马歇尔先生怎么说？

sentences.en: It's going to just happen.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样发生了。

sentences.en: I mean, we'll move promptly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们会迅速行动。

sentences.en: We'll move very swiftly.
sentences.zh: 我们会非常迅速地行动。

sentences.en: I paid my respects to Justice Marshall in a statement that we put out.
sentences.zh: 我在发表的一份声明中向马歇尔大法官表达了敬意。

sentences.en: He served his country with great distinction.
sentences.zh: 他以卓越的杰出表现为国家服务。

sentences.en: It starts with the retirement of Supreme Court Justice Thurgood Marshall, who's a legendary figure,
sentences.zh: 这一切始于最高法院大法官瑟古德·马歇尔的退休，他是一位传奇人物，

sentences.en: African-American Supreme Court Justice.
sentences.zh: 是一位非裔美国最高法院大法官。

sentences.en: And George H.W.
sentences.zh: 而总统老乔治·H·W·

sentences.en: Bush, the president, nominates another African-American man who's only been a judge for a year.
sentences.zh: 布什提名了另一位只当了一年法官的非裔美国男性。

sentences.en: I have followed this man's career for some time, and he has excelled in everything that he has attempted.
sentences.zh: 我关注这位先生的职业生涯有一段时间了，他在尝试过的每件事上都表现卓越。

sentences.en: He is a delightful and warm, intelligent person who has great empathy and a wonderful sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 他是一个令人愉快、热情、聪明的人，具有极大的同理心和极佳的幽默感。

sentences.en: And he's earned the right to sit on this nation's highest court, and I am very proud indeed.
sentences.zh: 他赢得了在这个国家最高法院就职的权利，我确实感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: A conservative judge named Clarence Thomas.
sentences.zh: 一位名为克拉伦斯·托马斯的保守派法官。

sentences.en: I'm honored and humbled by your nomination of me to be an associate justice of the Supreme Court of the United States.
sentences.zh: 承蒙您提名我担任美利坚合众国最高法院大法官，我深感荣幸和谦卑。

sentences.en: As a child, I could not dare dream that I would ever see the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 作为一个孩子，我做梦也没想到自己能见到最高法院。

sentences.en: So it seemed like this was going to be smooth sailing, that this confirmation was going to go right through.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来这将是一帆风顺，这次提名将顺利通过。

sentences.en: Clarence Thomas would be seated on the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 克拉伦斯·托马斯将就任最高法院大法官。

sentences.en: In an affidavit filed with the Senate Judiciary Committee, law professor Anita Hill said she had much in common with Clarence Thomas.
sentences.zh: 在提交给参议院司法委员会的一份宣誓书中，法学教授安妮塔·希尔表示她与克拉伦斯·托马斯有很多共同点。

sentences.en: He hired her as his personal assistant 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 10年前，他聘请她担任他的私人助理。

sentences.en: Then an FBI report was leaked to NPR's Nina Totenberg.
sentences.zh: 随后，一份FBI报告被泄露给NPR的尼娜·托滕贝格。

sentences.en: According to Hill's affidavit, Thomas soon began asking her out socially and refused to accept her explanation that she did not think it appropriate to go out with her boss.
sentences.zh: 根据希尔的宣誓书，托马斯不久后开始邀请她进行社交约会，并拒绝接受她认为与老板约会不合适的解释。

sentences.en: The relationship, she said, became even more strained when Thomas, in work situations, began to discuss sex.
sentences.zh: 她说，当托马斯在工作场合开始讨论性话题时，两人的关系变得更加紧张。

sentences.en: Nina, what impact do you think this is going to have?
sentences.zh: 尼娜，你认为这会产生什么影响？

sentences.en: I mean, this is bombshell timing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个时机太震撼了。

sentences.en: Well, I really don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我真的不知道。

sentences.en: The allegations were so striking and so completely out of the ordinary that the Senate Judiciary Committee had little choice but to reopen the hearings.
sentences.zh: 这些指控如此惊人，如此异乎寻常，以至于参议院司法委员会别无选择，只能重新开庭听证。

sentences.en: Welcome, Professor Hill.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，希尔教授。

sentences.en: Professor, let me explain what the procedure will be while your family and others are being seated.
sentences.zh: 教授，在您的家人和其他人就座期间，让我向您解释一下程序。

sentences.en: So you have these televised hearings.
sentences.zh: 所以你们有这些电视转播的听证会。

sentences.en: The whole world is watching.
sentences.zh: 全世界都在看着。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, Senator Thurman, members of the committee, my name is Anita F.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，瑟蒙德参议员，各位委员会成员，我叫安妮塔·F·

sentences.en: Hill, and I am a professor of law at the University of Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 希尔，我是俄克拉荷马大学的法学教授。

sentences.en: I was born on a farm in Okmulgee County,
sentences.zh: 1956年我出生在俄克拉荷马州

sentences.en: Oklahoma, in 1956.
sentences.zh: 奥克马尔吉县的一个农场里。

sentences.en: I am the youngest of 13 children.
sentences.zh: 我是13个孩子中最小的一个。

sentences.en: And what the whole world sees is a panel of all white men hearing testimony from this black woman who is really nervous.
sentences.zh: 全世界看到的是一个全由白人组成的专家小组，在听取这位非常紧张的黑人女性的证词。

sentences.en: She's not eager to testify.
sentences.zh: 她并不急于作证。

sentences.en: She's not eager to relive this chapter in her life.
sentences.zh: 她并不急于重温人生中的这一章。

sentences.en: But she's come forward to do this.
sentences.zh: 但她站出来做了这件事。

sentences.en: His conversations were very vivid.
sentences.zh: 他的谈话非常生动。

sentences.en: He spoke about acts that he had seen in pornographic films involving such matters as women having sex with animals and films showing group sex or rape scenes.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了他在色情电影中看到的行为，涉及诸如女性与动物发生性关系的事务，以及展示群交或强奸场景的电影。

sentences.en: On several occasions, Thomas told me graphically of his own sexual prowess.
sentences.zh: 在好几次场合中，托马斯生动地向我描述了他自己的性能力。

sentences.en: I happened to be returning from a trip to Europe.
sentences.zh: 我碰巧从欧洲旅行归来。

sentences.en: I was in Heathrow, the airport in London.
sentences.zh: 我在伦敦的希思罗机场。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, I saw this big crowd gather, big crowd, maybe 200 people gathered around the television set.
sentences.zh: 突然间，我看到聚集了很多人，很大的一群人，大约200人聚集在电视机周围。

sentences.en: And I went over.
sentences.zh: 我走了过去。

sentences.en: Professor Hill, you said that you took it to mean that Judge Thomas wanted to have sex with you, but...
sentences.zh: 希尔教授，您说您认为这是托马斯法官想和您发生性关系的意思，但是……

sentences.en: And what it was were the hearings.
sentences.zh: 而那里播放的正是听证会。

sentences.en: In fact, he never did ask you to have sex, correct?
sentences.zh: 事实上，他从未要求与您发生性关系，对吗？

sentences.en: No, he did not ask me to have sex.
sentences.zh: 没有，他没有要求与我发生性关系。

sentences.en: He did continually pressure me to go out with him, continually.
sentences.zh: 但他不断施压要我和他约会，不断地。

sentences.en: And he would not accept my explanation as one as being valid.
sentences.zh: 而且他拒绝接受我的解释，认为我的解释不成立。

sentences.en: And that's where I heard her testimony, standing in the airport in Heathrow.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，我听到了她的证词，当时我正站在希思罗机场。

sentences.en: It was a silent crowd, but it was a big crowd.
sentences.zh: 人群鸦雀无声，但人很多。

sentences.en: And that said something.
sentences.zh: 这说明了一些问题。

sentences.en: Now, in trying to determine whether you are telling falsehoods,
sentences.zh: 现在，为了确定你是否在说谎，

sentences.en: I've got to determine what your motivation might be.
sentences.zh: 我必须弄清楚你的动机可能是什么。

sentences.en: What I remember was an all-male table.
sentences.zh: 我记得是一张全男性面孔的桌子。

sentences.en: Are you a scorned woman?
sentences.zh: 你是一个被抛弃的怨妇吗？

sentences.en: Are you a zealot?
sentences.zh: 你是个狂热分子吗？

sentences.en: And I watched her being somewhat berated and asked some demeaning questions.
sentences.zh: 我看着她受到某种程度的指责，并被问到一些贬低的问题。

sentences.en: Do you have a militant attitude relative to the area of civil rights?
sentences.zh: 你在民权领域是否有激进的态度？

sentences.en: No, I don't have a militant attitude.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有激进的态度。

sentences.en: And she was even accused of lying.
sentences.zh: 她甚至被指控说谎。

sentences.en: If what you say this man said to you occurred,
sentences.zh: 如果你说这个对你说过的话是真实发生的，

sentences.en: why in God's name, when he left his position of power or authority over you, why in God's name would you ever speak to a man like that the rest of your life?
sentences.zh: 看在上帝的份上，当他不再对你拥有权力和权威时，看在上帝的份上，你为什么余生还要和这种人说话？

sentences.en: That's a very good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: I have suggested that I was afraid of retaliation.
sentences.zh: 我曾暗示过我害怕遭到报复。

sentences.en: I was afraid of damage to my professional life.
sentences.zh: 我害怕对我的职业生涯造成损害。

sentences.en: And I believe you have to understand that this, and that's one of the things that I have come to understand about harassment,
sentences.zh: 我想你必须明白这一点，这也是我开始理解关于骚扰的一点，

sentences.en: that this response, this kind of response, is not atypical.
sentences.zh: 这种反应，这种回应并不是不典型的。

sentences.en: And I can't explain.
sentences.zh: 我无法解释。

sentences.en: It takes an expert in psychology to explain how that can happen.
sentences.zh: 这需要心理学专家来解释这种情况是如何发生的。

sentences.en: But it can happen because it happened to me.
sentences.zh: 但这确实可能发生，因为这件事就发生在我身上。

sentences.en: I remember being a graduate student in the student lounge at the Columbia School of Journalism,
sentences.zh: 我记得自己当时是哥伦比亚新闻学院学生休息室的一名研究生，

sentences.en: and this being on television and people watching it and just seeing the looks of disgust on women's faces and sort of this sense of like, really, this is where we are?
sentences.zh: 当时电视上正播着这个，大家都在看，看到女性脸上的厌恶之情，那种感觉就像是，真的吗，我们现在竟然落得这般田地？

sentences.en: This woman is being treated so disrespectfully.
sentences.zh: 这个女人受到了如此不尊重的对待。

sentences.en: And what was that incident again?
sentences.zh: 那个事件具体是怎么回事来着？

sentences.en: The incident with regard to the Coke can that's spelled out in my statement.
sentences.zh: 就是我陈述中写到的那个关于可乐罐的事件。

sentences.en: Would you describe it once again for me, please?
sentences.zh: 请您再为我描述一遍好吗？

sentences.en: The incident involved...
sentences.zh: 那个事件涉及到……

sentences.en: You know, you have Joe Biden, who has made one run for the president at this point,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当时乔·拜登只竞选过一次总统，

sentences.en: is gearing up to run again, and he's questioning her about what Clarence Thomas said about his penis.
sentences.zh: 正准备再次参选，他质问她关于克拉伦斯·托马斯对他阴茎的言论。

sentences.en: Now, again, for the record, did he just say, I have great physical capability and attributes, or was he more graphic?
sentences.zh: 现在，为了记录在案，他刚才说的是我拥有很强的身体能力和特征，还是说得更露骨？

sentences.en: He was much more graphic.
